title: Mountain Pro Foundations
summary: Level 1 beginner training for self-sufficient outdoor adventure.
highlights: Learn self management and outdoor survival skills
Build wilderness first-aid, risk-management and field decision skills
Designed for complete beginners preparing for a trek or expedition

snapshot: Conceptualised by ex-military operatives after years of operational and training experience.
MoPro Foundations is the first step into the world of self-sufficient outdoor adventure.
The course introduces mountain travel, campcraft, movement techniques, navigation, outdoor hygiene, risk management, basic wilderness first aid and the mindset required to thrive in the mountains.
Built for complete beginners who want a strong base before progressing into trekking, mountaineering, climbing and expedition life.

title: Mountain Pro Practitioners
summary: Your second step into the world of self-sufficient outdoor adventure.
highlights: Learn the fundamentals of mountain travel, campcraft, movement techniques, navigation, outdoor hygiene, risk management, basic wilderness first aid, and the mindset required to thrive in the mountains.
Designed for people having some outdoor experience, who want to build a strong foundation before progressing into high altitude trekking, mountaineering, climbing, and expedition life.
The programme follows a military-inspired training methodology with emphasis on teamwork, leadership and self-sufficiency.
date: 9th Dec to 13th Dec 2026 & 25th Dec to 29th Dec 2026

snapshot: Conceptualised by Ex-Military Operatives after years of operational and training experience.
MOUNTAIN PRO is the flagship training programme of Alpine Operations & Expeditions.
Practitioners - Your second step into the world of self-sufficient outdoor adventure.

Learn the fundamentals of mountain travel, campcraft, movement techniques, navigation, outdoor hygiene, risk management, basic wilderness first aid, and the mindset required to thrive in the mountains.
Designed for people having some outdoor experience, who want to build a strong foundation before progressing into high altitude trekking, mountaineering, climbing, and expedition life.

pricing.title: Price
pricing.note: Note: Trainees are expected to reach the Base Camp under their own arrangements. Transportation can be arranged by Alpine Ops upon request, subject to a minimum group size of 3 or 6 participants, depending on the pickup location and logistics. Any transportation arranged by Alpine Ops is provided solely as a facilitation service. The agreement for such services remains directly between the trainees and the transport provider. Alpine Ops neither derives any profit from these arrangements nor assumes any responsibility or liability for the conduct, services, delays, or actions of the transport provider.

detail.footerNote: Timings are tentative and may change based on weather, training progress and operational requirements. Participants should be prepared for extended outdoor activity, uneven terrain and adverse weather conditions. The programme follows a military-inspired training methodology with emphasis on teamwork, leadership and self-sufficiency.

whoCanJoin: The MoPro Practitioners course consists of 9 modules delivered through theory classes, practical sessions, interactive discussions, lectures, and demonstrations. Beyond outdoor skills, the course focuses on Team Management, discipline, decision-making, and developing the mindset required to become a capable and self-sufficient mountain person.

title: Spiti Ice Climbing workshop
summary: The ultimate ice climbing workshop led by military experts.
highlights: Learn to climb frozen waterfalls from ex-military experts.
Professional training, world-class gear, and total safety.
The ultimate winter ice climbing workshop in the Himalayas.
Stay in beautiful homestays in Spiti and enjoy the local life and cuisine.

detail.snapshot: join this workshop in Spiti for a week of adventure across the frozen waterfalls of Tabo and Mane. Designed for both beginner and intermediate climbers, the program features hands-on training from ex-military instructors with years of cold-weather expertise, using international-standard gear and strict safety protocols. Beyond the climb, you’ll stay in traditional local homestays, enjoy authentic Spiti cuisine, and explore the region's unique culture and landscapes. It is the perfect blend of technical skill-building and a deep, adventurous dive into the heart of the Himalayas in winter.
detail.footerNote: Places are limited and filled on a first-come basis.

title: Black Peak Expedition
summary: A fully guided expedition to Black peak (Kala Nag) 6387m
highlights: A fully supported expedition to one of the most challanging peak in Uttrakhand
Professional guides, world-class gear, and total safety.
Led by experienced Ex-military team
location: Govind Pashu Vihar National Park, Uttarkashi

detail.snapshot: Standing at 6,387 meters (20,955 ft) in the Garhwal Himalayas of Uttarakhand, Black Peak—locally known as Kalanag for its dark, cobra-hooded summit ridge—is the classic step up into serious Himalayan mountaineering. This expedition is designed for experienced trekkers making the leap from high-altitude trekking to technical alpine climbing, combining scenic approach trails with glacier travel, fixed-rope ascents, and high-camp logistics.
detail.footerNote: Places are limited and filled on a first-come basis.
